assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single transparent-background game sprite of Yumyumping, the exact Teenieping character in the reference: lime-green twin pigtails, red bows, teal chef hat, cream face, teal dress with white bib. Preserve her recognizable face, hair colors, costume and polished soft 3D toy-render style. Square 1024x1024 PNG with genuine transparent alpha, no backdrop, no floor, no text, no circular border or UI, no extra characters. Center the whole character inside a circle inscribed in the square, leave about 10% clear outer margin so hat and feet fit on a circular game plate. Large expressive face and hands readable at 150 pixels. HUNGRY state: visibly hungry and eagerly waiting for dinner. Lean forward with wide OPEN eyes focused on a little fork held up beside the face, mouth open in an anticipatory small O, raised questioning eyebrows; other hand pressing her empty tummy. A small appetizing plate of food in front of her at waist height. Express hunger clearly and playfully without tears or distress. Upright forward-leaning silhouette. Not the generic smiling portrait or victory pose in the reference.

Create a transparent-background cutout of this same Teenieping, Yumyumping, in a completely different FULL AFTER DINNER pose: sitting with legs out, leaning back comfortably, both hands gently holding her rounded tummy, eyes closed with a contented smile. An empty plate at her feet. Teal chef hat, lime-green pigtails, red bow, teal dress and white bib, identical cute 3D character style. Whole character visible and centered. Real transparent background. No patterned background. No text.

validation: Both selected PNG files have real transparent alpha. Hungry: open eyes, raised fork, food and hand on tummy. Full: closed eyes, seated posture, hands on tummy and empty plate.
